name: National Football League
notes: SDV coverage starts with 1970, the first season of the merged league (two conferences, six divisions).

name: AFC East
notes: One lineage across the 2002 realignment (same name, same ESPN id 4). ESPN's abbreviation EAST collides with NFC East, so SDV uses AFCE.

name: AFC Central
notes: Dissolved in the 2002 realignment; its northern teams formed the AFC North, which ESPN (id 12 vs 5) and the league treat as a new division, so it is a separate lineage.

name: AFC North
notes: New in 2002 (BAL, CIN, CLE, PIT from the AFC Central); not a rename of the AFC Central.

name: AFC South
notes: New in 2002: HOU (expansion), IND (from AFC East), JAX and TEN (from AFC Central).

name: AFC West
notes: One lineage across 2002 (ESPN id 6); SEA left for the NFC West in 2002.

name: NFC East
notes: One lineage across 2002 (ESPN id 1); ARI left for the NFC West in 2002.

name: NFC Central
notes: Dissolved in 2002; the NFC North (ESPN id 10 vs 2) is a separate lineage. ESPN's group 10 'NFC North' in 2000-2001 holds only the Pro Bowl teams (98/99, 31/32) and is ignored.

name: NFC North
notes: New in 2002 (CHI, DET, GB, MIN from the NFC Central; TB left for the NFC South).

name: NFC South
notes: New in 2002: ATL, CAR, NO (from the NFC West) and TB (from the NFC Central).

name: NFC West
notes: One lineage across 2002 (ESPN id 3); gained SEA and ARI, lost ATL, CAR, NO.
